calls.title: GrowthBook setup
calls.summary: The team discussed the integration of GA4 event data stored in BigQuery with GrowthBook to facilitate A/B test analysis. They faced challenges including data inconsistencies in BigQuery, which correctly represented data about 50% of the time, and the need for proper mapping of experiment IDs between GrowthBook and BigQuery. Current custom queries hinder scalability, prompting a recommendation for a reusable general query to simplify data setups. The necessity of accessing BigQuery credentials was highlighted, as it is crucial for testing and validating queries. A follow-up meeting was scheduled for Wednesday to resolve these challenges, with Chris Sanders providing ongoing support to ensure efficient resolution of issues.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, BigQuery, GA4, Experiment assignment, SQL query, Metrics
